en: What is this place...?

I feel like I'm on the set of a sci-fi movie.
A mecha could pop out at any moment...

<CLT=cltMIND>It took every ounce of my strength
to hold in what I wanted to say.

This is...different from the other places we've
seen so far.

And this maze-like hallway... Perhaps it's to
defend the building that it leads to?

Let's go, Shuichi. We have no other direction
to move but forward.

My inner voice is telling me...
"Hope moves forward."
<CLT=cltMIND>I should investigate this area carefully.
<CLT=cltMIND>Electrohammer

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a panel that controls the alarm system
and electric barrier.

<CLT=cltMIND>I don't see any reason to turn
them back on, though...

<CLT=cltMIND>What is this?
This shutter is huge...
...It seems to be well fortified.

That is...an electric barrier. We can't raise the
shutter while it's active.

If they're protecting it this strongly,
there must be some secret in there.

That's a possibility. Let's investigate to see
if we can get in.
W-Wait, it's dangerous! Don't—

<CLT=cltMIND>Before I could finish my warning,
Keebo approached the shutter, and...
Wh-What is this!?
Keebo, get away from—

Oh my! Tsk, tsk, tsk! Don't you go setting off
the alarm now!

C'mon, c'mon, outta the way so I can turn
off that alarm.
Geez! You guys gotta be more careful!

Be careful? What was that alarm for?
It was so loud...
Oh, that's the alarm system.

You see that <CLT=cltSTRONG>motion sensor alarm<CLT=cltNORMAL> above
the shutter?

In order to turn it off, you need to use an
<CLT=cltSTRONG>alarm remote<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

A super-loud alarm will blare if you approach
the shutter without turning off the system.

...Why is there an alarm system here
of all places?

Puhuhu... This place is so important that it
needs beefed up security.

I guess while I'm here, I'll also explain that
electric barrier...

To turn it off, you gotta enter a 59-digit code
in the control panel next to the shutter.

I'll tell you what the code is, but only once.
So make sure you memorize it.

Wait... Slow down, please!
503... What was the rest?

Only three numbers!? C'mon, robot!
I know you can do better than that!

<CLT=cltMIND>An electric barrier and an alarm system.
That's pretty tight security...

<CLT=cltMIND>What are they guarding so closely?
What could be in there...?
Like I said, this is a very important place.

Well...it used to be important, but that was
a long time ago. Now it's just pointless.
Pointless?

Yep, it's pointless. So I may as well give you
guys the alarm remote.

You can use it to turn off the <CLT=cltSTRONG>motion sensor
alarm<CLT=cltNORMAL> above the shutter...
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*beep beep*
See? It turned off the alarm system, didn't it?

Now just use the control panel to deactivate
the electric barrier, and you can go inside.

Um... Can you repeat that code you mentioned
earlier?

Huh? How annoying. But since it's your first
visit, I'll let you inside just this once.

<CLT=cltMIND>Monokuma walked up to the control panel,
quickly punched in the numbers, and...
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*beeeeep!*

Okay, now you just gotta manually raise the
shutter and you can go inside.

You can either use the control panel inside to
restore the alarm system and electric barrier...

...or just use the control panel out here. Or do
nothing, and the barrier and alarm will stay off.
Well then, safe travels!

<CLT=cltMIND>...He just let us in to this highly-
secured area. What's his game?

Let's go, Shuichi. We have no other direction
to move but forward.

My inner voice is telling me...
"Hope moves forward."
Yeah...you're right.
<CLT=cltMIND>Bathroom Window

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.
Perhaps I'll never get used to these after all.

<CLT=cltMIND>The emergency lights are on.
It's part of the alarm system.
